method_limit: Illustrative response design only. No incident is open, no borrower breach has been observed, and these response paths are not executed agreements or Coinbase policy.

playbooks.exit_criteria: Coverage is restored to at least 1.25x and independently reconciled
playbooks.required_evidence: Current collateral valuation, exposure ledger, custody balance, and top-up or repayment confirmation

playbooks.exit_criteria: Ownership, first priority, enforceability, and lender control are all verified
playbooks.required_evidence: Ownership records, lien search, executed security documents, control agreement, and operating-procedure test

playbooks.exit_criteria: A complete route test finishes within four hours with reconciled proceeds
playbooks.required_evidence: Timestamped route test, transaction identifiers, fees, destination confirmation, and exception log

playbooks.exit_criteria: Unrestricted cash is at least $25 million or a documented waiver is approved
playbooks.required_evidence: Borrowing-entity bank statements, unrestricted-cash reconciliation, forecast, and remediation plan

playbooks.exit_criteria: Rating and repayment analysis are refreshed and the decision owner accepts the remediation plan
playbooks.required_evidence: Budget-to-actual bridge, revised cash forecast, variance explanation, and management action plan
playbooks.response_sla: next scheduled review; immediate if runway is affected

playbooks.exit_criteria: The lien is released or subordinated, or an authorized written waiver is effective
playbooks.required_evidence: Debt and lien documents, consent request, priority analysis, and proposed waiver or subordination terms

playbooks.exit_criteria: Pro forma concentration headroom is non-negative after the approved draw amount
playbooks.required_evidence: Current portfolio exposure report, shared-risk aggregation, requested draw, and limit-owner sign-off

playbooks.exit_criteria: The reporting package is complete, reconciled, and accepted by credit administration
playbooks.required_evidence: Complete monthly financial package, collateral report, covenant certificate, and exception explanation
playbooks.response_sla: within five business days after notice
